scope: Exposed Ferro macOS backend contracts; targeted behavior validation, not exhaustive pixel equivalence.

quartz.shared_inputs_note: Later commits change Quartz-only code or documentation; shared catalog and Skia inputs are unchanged.

skia.shared_inputs_note: Later commits change Quartz-only code or documentation; shared catalog and Skia inputs are unchanged.

media.note: No webcam is available. QR image processing after the media checkpoints adds unrelated uploads.

physical_drag_verification.method: User physical-mouse test of the corrected Quartz Metal ControlCatalog

native_caption.automation_limitation: Synthetic automation reaches AppKit with pressedMouseButtons=0; physical dragging was verified by hand instead.

limitations: No physical webcam; synthetic preview validates texture interop only.
Synthetic UI events cannot verify AppKit window dragging (pressedMouseButtons=0); physical dragging was confirmed by hand.
Intel/eGPU devices, physical GPU removal, HDR/wide-gamut display fidelity and other operating systems are unverified.
Native font metrics and rasterization differ from Skia; text quality is evaluated against Core Text.
Capture artifacts are local; commands in the audit regenerate them. Baseline checkpoints are historical, not final-source measurements.
